name: tikz-funfig
description: Schema-driven publication-quality TikZ and PGFPlots figure generation.

interface.longDescription: Create, migrate, validate, render, and compile scientific figures from stable FigureSpec recipes using TikZ, PGFPlots, LaTeX, and gnuplot, including managed implicit equations and curve-relative annotations.
defaultPrompt: Create a publication-quality scientific figure from my description.
Convert this existing TikZ or PGFPlots figure into a stable FigureSpec.
Build a surface, contour, heatmap, or vector-field figure from my data.
Plot this implicit equation with gnuplot and label points or intersections directly on the curve.
